answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 648 Country: India Title: Use of condom is allowed in Islam? Question: Use of condom is allowed in Islam? Answer ID: 648 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 658/J) Condom is used with many intentions and purposes. If the intention is correct and in accordance with Sharia law then it is allowed, otherwise not. If you want to know the detail regarding the same you should send the question again describing the intention of using condom. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
